text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute doesn't show up for
training. After
searching for a while, I
eventually find her in a
classroom
making something.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm making a key holder out of beads for
one of
my classmates.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
What about you, Trainer? What brings
you here?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute seems completely
unaware of the
situation, so I let her
know that she's late for
training.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Is this the kind of joke people are telling
these
d—oh goodness me. The sun's
already setting.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. I was so focused, I must've lost
all track
of time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her apology seems genuine, so I decide
to let her
off with a warning and a
reminder to be careful.
